name: keys: multi-word name whose two key forms coincide yields one key
spec_quote: "Two Sigma" → ["twosigma"]

name: keys: legal-suffix form kept only in the company-key (incorporated is not a legal suffix in key (2))
spec_quote: "Ingredion Incorporated" → ["ingredion", "ingredionincorporated"]

name: keys: name that is only a dropped generic key yields no keys
spec_quote: A key shorter than 3 characters, or equal to one of apply, careers, career, jobs, job, join, work, home, recruiting, talent, hiring, is dropped. ... "Apply" → [].

name: keys: generic-only name falls back to company-key words other than the/and/of, plus full squashed company key
spec_quote: when no distinctive word is left after dropping generic words (e.g. "Bank of America"), the distinctive words are the company key's words other than the, and, of (one-letter words still dropped) → "bank", "america"; and (2) the company key ... with every non-alphanumeric character removed

name: keys: 'technologies' removed as legal suffix in both keys, duplicates dropped
spec_quote: the distinctive words of the name ... joined with no spaces; (2) the company key (lower-case, legal suffixes inc / llc / corp / corporation / co / company / ltd / group / technologies / technology / holdings / lab / labs removed) with every non-alphanumeric character removed ... in this order, no duplicates

name: keys: resulting key shorter than 3 characters is dropped
spec_quote: A key shorter than 3 characters ... is dropped.

name: hint_of: greenhouse board URL is detected as the ATS
spec_quote: ("greenhouse", "Acme", "https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/acme") → ["greenhouse", "acme"]

name: hint_of: successfactors file with unrecognised URL uses the URL host
spec_quote: ("successfactors", "Roche", "https://careers.roche.com") → ["successfactors", "careers.roche.com"]

name: hint_of: successfactors row whose name is a generic dropped word yields null
spec_quote: ("successfactors", "Apply", "https://apply.iav.com") → null

name: hint_of: non-phenom/successfactors file with unrecognised URL yields null
spec_quote: ("gem", "X", "https://jobs.gem.com/x") → null ... Any other file with an unrecognised url → null.

name: hint_of: lever URL is detected even from a lever file
spec_quote: If detect_ats(url) finds something, its first result.

name: hint_of: phenom file row uses the URL host
spec_quote: Otherwise, only when fname is "phenom" or "successfactors": [fname, the url's host lower-case]

name: hint_of: successfactors row whose name is 'Careers' is skipped (case-insensitive)
spec_quote: unless the name (trimmed, lower-case) is one of the words above (apply, careers, …)

name: lookup: two files, only the matching row's file contributes a hint
spec_quote: lookup(company, directory) reads every *.csv in directory. ... lookup returns the hints filed under the company's keys (keys in order, hints in file-then-row order), no duplicates

name: lookup: phenom-style row (first field is the url)
spec_quote: rows are name,slug,url — except a row whose first field starts with "http", which is url,name,… (the phenom file)

name: lookup: duplicate hints for the same company are returned once
spec_quote: a hint is filed under every key of the row's name. lookup returns the hints filed under the company's keys ..., no duplicates

name: lookup: company matching a row name that differs only by legal suffix; longer different name not returned
spec_quote: a hint is filed under every key of the row's name. lookup returns the hints filed under the company's keys ...; [] when none.

name: lookup: no matching company gives empty list
spec_quote: lookup returns the hints filed under the company's keys (keys in order, hints in file-then-row order), no duplicates; [] when none.

name: lookup: hint filed under every key of the row name matches the shorter company key
spec_quote: a hint is filed under every key of the row's name. lookup returns the hints filed under the company's keys (keys in order, hints in file-then-row order), no duplicates

name: lookup: row producing a null hint is skipped and other rows still yield hints
spec_quote: Each row → hint_of(file name without .csv, name, url); a hint is filed under every key of the row's name. ... unless the name (trimmed, lower-case) is one of the words above (apply, careers, …)
